senses.gloss: Sacerdotal,Ⓒa.Ⓓpurohita in comp.; yAja-kIya, pOrohita (tI f.).

Sack,Ⓒs.ⒹsyUtaH, prasevaH, syotaH, syUnaH, SARa-puwaH-kozaH, goRI.
Ⓑ
 2 luMWanaM, apahAraH, DanAdeH apaharaRaM; ‘s(ack) cloth’ SARapawaH-vastraM, varASiH, sTUlaSAwakaH, SARaM.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹluMW 1 P, 10, upaplu 1 A, sarvasvaM apahf 1 P.

Sacred,Ⓒa.ⒹpuRya, pavitra, pari-, pUta, meDya, Suci.
Ⓑ
 2 alOkika-asAMsArika-vEdika- (kI f.), (opposed to profane).
Ⓑ
 3 pUjya, pUjArha; BAvitAtman.
Ⓑ
 4 puRyArTaka, su-pratizWitaH.
Ⓑ
 5 anatikramaRIya, alaMGya, aBedya; durDarza, avaDya (person); ‘an ambassador, being considered s(acred), never tells an untruth’ sadEvAvaDyaBAvena dUto vadati nAnyaTA (H. 3); ‘s(acred) spot’ kzetraM puRyasTAnaM, tIrTaM; ‘s(acred) grove’ puRyavanaM, tapovanaH ‘s(acred) knowledge’ nigama-veda-jYAnaM, Sruti-boDaH; ‘s(acred) writing’ vedaH, nigamaH, Sruti f.

Sacrifice,Ⓒs.ⒹyajYaH; kratuH, aDvaraH, yAgaH, ijyA, maKaH, savaH, homaH, havanaM, izwi f., meDaH in comp.; ‘horse-s(acrifice)’ aSvameDaH; ‘human s(acrifice)’ narameDaH-yajYaH &c.; ‘imperial s(acrifice)’ rAjasUyaH; ‘fit for a s(acrifice)’ yajYiya, meDya.
Ⓑ
 2 AlaMBaH, utsargaH, baliH, upahAraH.
Ⓑ
 3 vyayaH, utsargaH, pari-, tyAgaH, viniyogaH, samarpaRaM; ‘even at the s(acrifice) of oneʼs life’ jIvitavyayenApi, prARaparityAgenApi; oft. by instr. alone (AtmAnaM satataM rakzet dArErapi DanErapi).
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓyaj 1 U; hu 3 U, upahf 1 P, utsargArTaM han 2 P or baliM dA 3 U, samA-A laB 1 A (animal); ‘he s(acrifice)s a beast to Rudra’ paSunA rudraM yajate; ‘he s(acrific)ed a horse’ aSvameDaM tatAna, aSva-meDena Ije.
Ⓑ
 2 pari-tyaj 1 P, ut-sfj 6 P, hA 3 P, saM-f c. (arpayati), viniyuj 7 A, 10; ‘s(acrific)ing their own interests’ svArTaM parityajya; ‘without s(acrific)ing their interest’ svArTAviroDena (Bh. i. 74).
Ⓝ[Sacrific]er,Ⓒs.ⒹyajamAnaH, yazwf m., yAjakaH, yajvan m., yAjYikaH, hotf m.
ⓃSacrificial,Ⓒa.ⒹyajYiya, vEtAna (nI f.), meDya; yajYa in comp.; ‘s(acrificial) work’ yajYakarma; ‘s(acrificial) fire’ homAgniH, samUhyaH, pari-cAyyaH, upacAyyaH; ‘s(acrificial) priest’ ftvij m.; See Priest; ‘s(acrificial) session’ satraM.

Sacrilege,Ⓒs.ⒹdevatAdUzaRaM, devasvApaharaRaM, deva-svacOryaM, puRyavastudUzaRaM; DarmalaMGanaM-lopaH
ⓃSacrilegious,Ⓒa.ⒹdevasvApahArin; puRya-dravya-dUzin.
